head_commit.message:
pm-255/t-1632: Accept only the tier-off GET /api/ask 404 in the seasons joint check

The Ask console's GET /api/ask on open answers 404 with the model tier off (lib/ask-tier.ts enabled:false), and Chromium logs that load as a console error. Each recorded GET /api/ask 404 response now allows one matching console error; any POST, other status, other URL or page error still fails. A negative control in the same page injects another URL's 404, a browser-routed GET /api/ask 500 and a console.error and requires all three counted. Joint stays 28 checks.
